known_issues.detail: Cargo build.rs reruns Meson with upstream defaults, overwriting the RPM-configured paths with /usr/local/share/phosh-first-boot and /run/phosh-first-boot. Hardware 1.1 and extracted signed 1.2 binary confirm incorrect paths. Requires a rebuilt package that preserves the preconfigured Meson values.
